totals.note: Rebuilt per canonical process from 14 extractions (114 process records; 2 excluded as the same work described twice; 14 described but not costed). Each actor counted once per process; shares from managers who also described a colleague's work were cut to their own share. Seven people's high ends exceeded 160 h/month and were scaled down on their assumed items only. Only 13% of the mid-point hours rest on stated times – almost every time per task is assumed – so the low is the defensible figure and the high is a ceiling, not an estimate.
